396				if _, err := identityManager.EnsureProjectIdentity(); err != nil {
397					// Log error but don't fail the command
398					slog.Error("Failed to ensure project identity", "error", err)
399				}
400	
401				// Create context for graceful cancellation (Ctrl+C handling)
402				ctx, cancel := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
403				defer cancel()
404	
405				// Start provenance infrastructure before the agent so all file changes are captured
406				provenanceEngine, provenanceCleanup, err := provenance.StartEngine(provenanceEnabled)
407				if err != nil {
408					return err
409				}
410				defer provenanceCleanup()
411	
412				fsCleanup, err := provenance.StartFSWatcher(ctx, provenanceEngine, cwd)
413				if err != nil {
414					return err
415				}
416				defer fsCleanup()
417	
418				// Check authentication for cloud sync
419				cmdpkg.CheckAndWarnAuthentication(noCloudSync)
420				// Track extension activation
421				analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventExtensionActivated, nil)
422	
423				// Get resume session ID if provided
424				resumeSessionID, _ := cmd.Flags().GetString("resume")
425				if resumeSessionID != "" {
426					resumeSessionID = strings.TrimSpace(resumeSessionID)
427					// Note: Different providers may have different session ID formats
428					// Let the provider validate its own format
429					slog.Info("Resuming session", "sessionId", resumeSessionID)
430				}
431	
432				// Get debug-raw flag value (must be before callback to capture in closure)
433				debugRaw, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("debug-raw")
434				useUTC := !localTimeZone
435	
436				// Keep sessions.db current in real time alongside the markdown writes (nil/no-op
437				// if the index can't be opened — never block the running agent on it).
438				liveIndex := cmdpkg.NewLiveIndexer(cwd)
439				defer liveIndex.Close()
440	
441				// This callback pattern enables real-time processing of agent sessions
442				// without blocking the agent's execution. As the agent writes updates to its
443				// data files, the provider's watcher detects changes and invokes this callback,
444				// allowing immediate markdown generation and cloud sync. Errors are logged but
445				// don't stop execution because transient failures (e.g., network issues) shouldn't
446				// interrupt the user's coding session.
447				sessionCallback := func(session *spi.AgentChatSession) {
448					if session == nil {
449						return
450					}
451	
452					// Track the session ID for deep linking on exit
453					lastRunSessionID = session.SessionID
454	
455					// Process the session (write markdown and sync to cloud)
456					// Don't show output during interactive run mode
457					// This is autosave mode (true)
458					_, err := sessionpkg.ProcessSingleSession(context.Background(), session, config, sessionpkg.ProcessingOptions{
459						OnlyCloudSync:      onlyCloudSync,
460						IsAutosave:         true,
461						DebugRaw:           debugRaw,
462						UseUTC:             useUTC,
463						NoTelemetryPrompts: noTelemetryPrompts,
464					})
465					if err != nil {
466						// Log error but continue - don't fail the whole run
467						// In interactive mode, we prioritize keeping the agent running.
468						// Failed markdown writes or cloud syncs can be retried later via
469						// the sync command, so we just log and continue.
470						slog.Error("Failed to process session update",
471							"sessionId", session.SessionID,
472							"error", err)
473					}
474	
475					// Mirror the markdown write into the restore index in real time.
476					liveIndex.Record(providerID, session)
477	
478					// Push agent events to provenance engine for correlation
479					provenance.ProcessEvents(ctx, provenanceEngine, session)
480				}
481	
482				// Execute the agent and watch for updates
483				slog.Info("Starting agent execution and monitoring", "provider", provider.Name())
484				err = provider.ExecAgentAndWatch(cwd, customCmd, resumeSessionID, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
485	
486				if err != nil {
487					slog.Error("Agent execution failed", "provider", provider.Name(), "error", err)
488				}
489	
490				return err
491			},
492		}
493	}
494	
495	var runCmd *cobra.Command
496	
497	// createSyncCommand dynamically creates the sync command with provider information
498	func createSyncCommand() *cobra.Command {
499		registry := factory.GetRegistry()
500		ids := registry.ListIDs()
501		providerList := registry.GetProviderList()
502	
503		// Build dynamic examples
504		examples := `
505	# Sync all agents with activity
506	specstory sync`
507	
508		if len(ids) > 0 {
509			examples += "\n\n# Sync specific agent"
510			for _, id := range ids {
511				examples += fmt.Sprintf("\nspecstory sync %s", id)
512			}
513		}
514	
515		examples += `
516	
517	# Sync a specific session by UUID
518	specstory sync -s <session-id>
519	
520	# Sync multiple sessions
521	specstory sync -s <session-id-1> -s <session-id-2> -s <session-id-3>
522	
523	# Output session markdown to stdout without saving
524	specstory sync -s <session-id> --print
525	
526	# Output multiple sessions to stdout
527	specstory sync -s <session-id-1> -s <session-id-2> --print
528	
529	# Sync all sessions for the current directory, with console output
530	specstory sync --console
531	
532	# Sync all sessions for the current directory, with a log file
533	specstory sync --log`
534	
535		longDesc := `Create or update markdown files for the agent sessions in the current working directory.
536	
537	By default, syncs all registered providers that have activity.
538	Provide a specific agent ID to sync a specific provider.`
539		if providerList != "No providers registered" {
540			longDesc += "\n\nAvailable provider IDs: " + providerList + "."
541		}
542	
543		return &cobra.Command{
544			Use:     "sync [provider-id]",
545			Aliases: []string{"s"},
546			Short:   "Sync markdown files for terminal coding agent sessions",
547			Long:    longDesc,
548			Example: examples,
549			Args:    cobra.MaximumNArgs(1), // Accept 0 or 1 argument (provider ID)
550			PreRunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
551				// Validate that --print requires -s flag
552				sessionIDs, _ := cmd.Flags().GetStringSlice("session")
553				if printToStdout && len(sessionIDs) == 0 {
554					return utils.ValidationError{Message: "--print requires the -s/--session flag to specify which sessions to output"}
555				}
556				if onlyStats && len(sessionIDs) > 0 {
557					return utils.ValidationError{Message: "cannot use --only-stats with -s/--session. Use --only-stats without -s to collect statistics for all sessions"}
558				}
559				return nil
560			},
561			RunE: func(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string) error {
562				config.EnsureDefaultProjectConfig()
563	
564				// Get session IDs if provided via flag
565				sessionIDs, _ := cmd.Flags().GetStringSlice("session")
566	
567				// Handle specific session sync if -s flag is provided
568				if len(sessionIDs) > 0 {
569					return syncSpecificSessions(cmd, args, sessionIDs)
570				}
571	
572				slog.Info("Running sync command")
573				registry := factory.GetRegistry()
574	
575				// Check if user specified a provider
576				if len(args) > 0 {
577					// Sync specific provider
578					return syncSingleProvider(registry, args[0], cmd)
579				} else {
580					// Sync all providers with activity
581					return syncAllProviders(registry, cmd)
582				}
583			},
584		}
585	}
586	
587	// syncSpecificSessions syncs one or more sessions by their IDs
588	// When printToStdout is set, outputs markdown to stdout instead of saving to files.
589	// args[0] is the optional provider ID
590	func syncSpecificSessions(cmd *cobra.Command, args []string, sessionIDs []string) error {
591		if len(sessionIDs) == 1 {
592			slog.Info("Running single session sync", "sessionId", sessionIDs[0])
593		} else {
594			slog.Info("Running multiple session sync", "sessionCount", len(sessionIDs))
595		}
596	
597		// Get debug-raw flag value
598		debugRaw, _ := cmd.Flags().GetBool("debug-raw")
599		useUTC := !localTimeZone
600	
601		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
602		if err != nil {
603			slog.Error("Failed to get current working directory", "error", err)
604			return err
605		}
606	
607		// Setup file output and cloud sync (not needed for --print mode)
608		var config utils.OutputConfig
609		// liveIndex keeps sessions.db current for the sessions we save. Skipped for --print, which
610		// outputs to stdout without saving (so there's nothing to "sync"). Best-effort no-op on nil.
611		var liveIndex *cmdpkg.LiveIndexer
612		if !printToStdout {
613			config, err = utils.SetupOutputConfig(outputDir, debugDir)
614			if err != nil {
615				return err
616			}
617	
618			identityManager := utils.NewProjectIdentityManager(cwd)
619			if _, err := identityManager.EnsureProjectIdentity(); err != nil {
620				slog.Error("Failed to ensure project identity", "error", err)
621			}
622	
623			cmdpkg.CheckAndWarnAuthentication(noCloudSync || onlyStats)
624	
625			if err := utils.EnsureHistoryDirectoryExists(config); err != nil {
626				return err
627			}
628	
629			liveIndex = cmdpkg.NewLiveIndexer(cwd)
630			defer liveIndex.Close()
631		}
632	
633		registry := factory.GetRegistry()
634	
635		// Track statistics for summary output
636		var successCount, notFoundCount, errorCount int
637		var lastError error
638	
639		// Resolve provider once if specified (fail fast if provider not found)
640		var specifiedProvider spi.Provider
641		if len(args) > 0 {
642			providerID := args[0]
643			provider, err := registry.Get(providerID)
644			if err != nil {
645				if !printToStdout {
646					fmt.Printf("❌ Provider '%s' not found\n", providerID)
647				}
648				return fmt.Errorf("provider '%s' not found: %w", providerID, err)
649			}
650			specifiedProvider = provider
651		}
652	
653		// Process each session ID
654		var printedSessions int // tracks sessions printed to stdout for separator logic
655		for _, sessionID := range sessionIDs {
656			sessionID = strings.TrimSpace(sessionID)
657			if sessionID == "" {
658				continue // Skip empty session IDs
659			}
660	
661			// Find session across providers
662			var session *spi.AgentChatSession
663			var foundAgentID string // registry id of the provider that has this session (for indexing)
664	
665			// Case A: Provider was specified - use it directly
666			if specifiedProvider != nil {
667				session, err = specifiedProvider.GetAgentChatSession(cwd, sessionID, debugRaw)
668				if err != nil {
669					if !printToStdout {
670						fmt.Printf("❌ Error getting session '%s' from %s: %v\n", sessionID, specifiedProvider.Name(), err)
671					}
672					slog.Error("Error getting session from provider", "sessionId", sessionID, "provider", specifiedProvider.Name(), "error", err)
673					errorCount++
674					lastError = err
675					continue
676				}
677				if session == nil {
678					if !printToStdout {
679						fmt.Printf("❌ Session '%s' not found in %s\n", sessionID, specifiedProvider.Name())
680					}
681					slog.Warn("Session not found in provider", "sessionId", sessionID, "provider", specifiedProvider.Name())
682					notFoundCount++
683					continue
684				}
685				foundAgentID = args[0]
686			} else {
687				// Case B: No provider specified - try all providers
688				providerIDs := registry.ListIDs()
689				for _, id := range providerIDs {
690					provider, err := registry.Get(id)
691					if err != nil {
692						continue
693					}
694	
695					session, err = provider.GetAgentChatSession(cwd, sessionID, debugRaw)
696					if err != nil {
697						slog.Debug("Error checking provider for session", "provider", id, "sessionId", sessionID, "error", err)
698						continue
699					}
700					if session != nil {
701						foundAgentID = id
702						if !silent && !printToStdout {
703							fmt.Printf("✅ Found session '%s' for %s\n", sessionID, provider.Name())
704						}
705						break // Found it, don't check other providers
706					}
707				}
708	
709				if session == nil {
710					if !printToStdout {
711						fmt.Printf("❌ Session '%s' not found in any provider\n", sessionID)
712					}
713					slog.Warn("Session not found in any provider", "sessionId", sessionID)
714					notFoundCount++
715					continue
716				}
717			}
718	
719			// Process the found session
720			if printToStdout {
721				sessionpkg.ValidateSessionData(session, debugRaw)
722				sessionpkg.WriteDebugSessionData(session, debugRaw)
723	
724				markdownContent, err := sessionpkg.GenerateMarkdownFromAgentSession(session.SessionData, false, useUTC)
725				if err != nil {
726					slog.Error("Failed to generate markdown", "sessionId", session.SessionID, "error", err)
727					analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownError, analytics.Properties{
728						"session_id": session.SessionID,
729						"error":      err.Error(),
730						"mode":       "print",
731					})
732					errorCount++
733					lastError = err
734					continue
735				}
736	
737				// Separate multiple sessions with a horizontal rule
738				if printedSessions > 0 {
739					fmt.Print("\n---\n\n")
740				}
741				fmt.Print(markdownContent)
742				printedSessions++
743				successCount++
744				analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownSuccess, analytics.Properties{
745					"session_id": session.SessionID,
746					"mode":       "print",
747				})
748			} else {
749				// Normal sync: write to file and optionally cloud sync
750				if _, err := sessionpkg.ProcessSingleSession(context.Background(), session, config, sessionpkg.ProcessingOptions{
751					OnlyCloudSync:      onlyCloudSync,
752					ShowOutput:         true,
753					DebugRaw:           debugRaw,
754					UseUTC:             useUTC,
755					NoTelemetryPrompts: noTelemetryPrompts,
756				}); err != nil {
757					errorCount++
758					lastError = err
759				} else {
760					successCount++
761					// Mirror the synced session into the restore index.
762					liveIndex.Record(foundAgentID, session)
763				}
764			}
765		}
766	
767		// Print summary if multiple sessions were processed (not for --print mode)
768		if !printToStdout && len(sessionIDs) > 1 && !silent {
769			fmt.Println()
770			fmt.Println("📊 Session sync summary:")
771			fmt.Printf("  ✅ %d %s successfully synced\n", successCount, pluralSession(successCount))
772			if notFoundCount > 0 {
773				fmt.Printf("  ❌ %d %s not found\n", notFoundCount, pluralSession(notFoundCount))
774			}
775			if errorCount > 0 {
776				fmt.Printf("  ❌ %d %s failed with errors\n", errorCount, pluralSession(errorCount))
777			}
778			fmt.Println()
779		}
780	
781		// Return error if any sessions failed
782		if errorCount > 0 || (notFoundCount > 0 && successCount == 0) {
783			if lastError != nil {
784				return lastError
785			}
786			return fmt.Errorf("%d %s not found", notFoundCount, pluralSession(notFoundCount))
787		}
788	
789		return nil
790	}
791	
792	// preloadBulkSessionSizesIfNeeded optimizes bulk syncs by fetching all session sizes upfront.
793	// This avoids making individual HEAD requests for each session during sync operations.
794	//
795	// The function only performs the preload if:
796	//   - Cloud sync is enabled (noCloudSync flag is false)
797	//   - User is authenticated with SpecStory Cloud
798	//   - A valid projectID can be determined from the identity manager
799	//
800	// Parameters:
801	//   - identityManager: Provides project identity (git_id or workspace_id) for the current project
802	//
803	// The preloaded sizes are cached in the SyncManager and shared across all providers since they
804	// use the same projectID. If the bulk fetch fails or if projectID cannot be determined, individual
805	// sessions will gracefully fall back to HEAD requests during sync.
806	//
807	// This function is safe to call multiple times but should typically be called once before processing
808	// multiple sessions in batch sync operations.
809	func preloadBulkSessionSizesIfNeeded(identityManager *utils.ProjectIdentityManager) {
810		// Skip if cloud sync is disabled or user is not authenticated
811		if noCloudSync || !cloud.IsAuthenticated() {
812			return
813		}
814	
815		// Get projectID from identity manager - required for cloud sync
816		projectID, err := identityManager.GetProjectID()
817		if err != nil {
818			slog.Warn("Cannot preload session sizes: failed to get project ID", "error", err)
819			return
820		}
821	
822		// Preload bulk sizes once - shared across all providers since they use same projectID
823		if syncMgr := cloud.GetSyncManager(); syncMgr != nil {
824			syncMgr.PreloadSessionSizes(projectID)
825		} else {
826			slog.Warn("Cannot preload session sizes: sync manager is nil despite authentication")
827		}
828	}
829	
830	// syncProvider performs the actual sync for a single provider.
831	// The caller-provided statsCollector accumulates statistics across providers so
832	// they can be flushed to disk in a single I/O operation after all providers are done.
833	// Returns (sessionCount, error) for analytics tracking.
834	func syncProvider(provider spi.Provider, providerID string, config utils.OutputConfig, debugRaw bool, useUTC bool, statsCollector *sessionpkg.StatisticsCollector) (int, error) {
835		cwd, err := os.Getwd()
836		if err != nil {
837			slog.Error("Failed to get current working directory", "error", err)
838			return 0, err
839		}
840	
841		// Keep sessions.db current for this project as we sync. We already hold each session's
842		// SessionData below, so indexing it is essentially free. Best-effort: a nil indexer (open
843		// failure) is a safe no-op and never affects the sync. Scoped to the synced project (cwd).
844		liveIndex := cmdpkg.NewLiveIndexer(cwd)
845		defer liveIndex.Close()
846	
847		// Create progress callback for parsing phase
848		// The callback updates the "Parsing..." line in place with [n/m] progress
849		var parseProgress spi.ProgressCallback
850		if !silent {
851			providerName := provider.Name()
852			parseProgress = func(current, total int) {
853				fmt.Printf("\rParsing %s sessions [%d/%d]", providerName, current, total)
854				_ = os.Stdout.Sync()
855			}
856		}
857	
858		// Get all sessions from the provider
859		sessions, err := provider.GetAgentChatSessions(cwd, debugRaw, parseProgress)
860		if err != nil {
861			return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to get sessions: %w", err)
862		}
863	
864		sessionCount := len(sessions)
865	
866		if sessionCount == 0 && !silent {
867			// This comes after "Parsing..." message, on the same line
868			fmt.Printf(", no non-empty sessions found for %s\n", provider.Name())
869			fmt.Println()
870			return 0, nil
871		}
872	
873		if !silent && !onlyStats {
874			fmt.Printf("\nSyncing markdown files for %s", provider.Name())
875		}
876	
877		// Initialize statistics
878		stats := &SyncStats{
879			TotalSessions: sessionCount,
880		}
881	
882		historyPath := config.GetHistoryDir()
883		agentName := provider.Name()
884		ctx := context.Background()
885	
886		// Process each session
887		for i := range sessions {
888			session := &sessions[i]
889	
890			// Process session in a closure so defers scope to each iteration,
891			// ensuring spans are ended and metrics recorded even on early returns.
892			func() {
893				processingStart := time.Now()
894	
895				// Create a context with a deterministic trace ID from the session ID
896				sessionCtx := telemetry.ContextWithSessionTrace(ctx, session.SessionID)
897	
898				// Start an OTel span for this session processing
899				sessionCtx, span := telemetry.Tracer("specstory").Start(sessionCtx, "process_session")
900				defer span.End()
901	
902				// Compute session statistics
903				sessionStats := telemetry.ComputeSessionStats(agentName, session)
904				defer func() {
905					telemetry.RecordSessionMetrics(sessionCtx, sessionStats, time.Since(processingStart))
906				}()
907	
908				// Set session span attributes
909				telemetry.SetSessionSpanAttributes(span, sessionStats)
910	
911				// Create child spans for each exchange
912				if session.SessionData != nil && len(session.SessionData.Exchanges) > 0 {
913					telemetry.ProcessExchangeSpans(sessionCtx, sessionStats, session.SessionData.Exchanges, noTelemetryPrompts)
914				}
915	
916				sessionpkg.ValidateSessionData(session, debugRaw)
917				sessionpkg.WriteDebugSessionData(session, debugRaw)
918	
919				// Mirror this session into the restore index as we sync it (covers normal and
920				// only-stats modes — we have the SessionData either way).
921				liveIndex.Record(providerID, session)
922	
923				// Generate markdown from SessionData
924				markdownContent, err := sessionpkg.GenerateMarkdownFromAgentSession(session.SessionData, false, useUTC)
925				if err != nil {
926					slog.Error("Failed to generate markdown from SessionData",
927						"sessionId", session.SessionID,
928						"error", err)
929					// Track sync error
930					analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownError, analytics.Properties{
931						"session_id": session.SessionID,
932						"error":      err.Error(),
933					})
934					return
935				}
936	
937				// Compute statistics from the SessionData
938				sessionStatistics := sessionpkg.ComputeSessionStatistics(session.SessionData, markdownContent, providerID)
939				statsCollector.AddSessionStats(session.SessionID, sessionStatistics)
940	
941				// In only-stats mode, skip file writes and cloud sync
942				if onlyStats {
943					stats.SessionsSkipped++
944					slog.Info("Skipping local file write (only-stats mode)", "sessionId", session.SessionID)
945					return
946				}
947	
948				// Generate filename from timestamp and slug
949				fileFullPath := sessionpkg.BuildSessionFilePath(session, historyPath, useUTC)
950	
951				// Check if file already exists with same content
952				identicalContent := false
953				fileExists := false
954				if existingContent, err := os.ReadFile(fileFullPath); err == nil {
955					fileExists = true
956					if string(existingContent) == markdownContent {
957						identicalContent = true
958						slog.Info("Markdown file already exists with same content, skipping write",
959							"sessionId", session.SessionID,
960							"path", fileFullPath)
961					}
962				}
963	
964				// Write file if needed (skip if only-cloud-sync is enabled)
965				if !onlyCloudSync {
966					if !identicalContent {
967						// Ensure history directory exists (handles deletion during long-running sync)
968						if err := utils.EnsureHistoryDirectoryExists(config); err != nil {
969							slog.Error("Failed to ensure history directory", "error", err)
970							return
971						}
972						err := os.WriteFile(fileFullPath, []byte(markdownContent), 0644)
973						if err != nil {
974							slog.Error("Error writing markdown file",
975								"sessionId", session.SessionID,
976								"error", err)
977							// Track sync error
978							analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownError, analytics.Properties{
979								"session_id":      session.SessionID,
980								"error":           err.Error(),
981								"only_cloud_sync": onlyCloudSync,
982							})
983							return
984						}
985						slog.Info("Successfully wrote file",
986							"sessionId", session.SessionID,
987							"path", fileFullPath)
988	
989						// Track successful sync
990						if !fileExists {
991							analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownNew, analytics.Properties{
992								"session_id":      session.SessionID,
993								"only_cloud_sync": onlyCloudSync,
994							})
995						} else {
996							analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventSyncMarkdownSuccess, analytics.Properties{
997								"session_id":      session.SessionID,
998								"only_cloud_sync": onlyCloudSync,
999							})
1000						}
1001					}
1002	
1003					// Update statistics for normal mode
1004					if identicalContent {
1005						stats.SessionsSkipped++
1006					} else if fileExists {
1007						stats.SessionsUpdated++
1008					} else {
1009						stats.SessionsCreated++
1010					}
1011				} else {
1012					// In cloud-only mode, count as skipped since no local file operation occurred
1013					stats.SessionsSkipped++
1014					slog.Info("Skipping local file write (only-cloud-sync mode)",

12	// CheckForUpdates checks for newer versions of the CLI and displays a notification if available
13	func CheckForUpdates(currentVersion string, noVersionCheck bool, silent bool) {
14		if noVersionCheck || currentVersion == "dev" {
15			return
16		}
17		defer func() {
18			if r := recover(); r != nil {
19				// Silently recover from any panic during version check
20				slog.Error("Version check panicked", "error", r)
21			}
22		}()
23	
24		// Create HTTP client with timeout to avoid delays
25		client := &http.Client{
26			Timeout: 2500 * time.Millisecond,
27			CheckRedirect: func(req *http.Request, via []*http.Request) error {
28				// Don't follow redirects - we want to capture the redirect URL
29				return http.ErrUseLastResponse
30			},
31		}
32	
33		// Make HEAD request to get redirect URL
34		resp, err := client.Head("https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/releases/latest")
35		if err != nil {
36			slog.Error("Version check failed", "error", err)
37			return
38		}
39		defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }() // HEAD request has minimal body; safe to ignore close error
40	
41		// Get redirect location
42		location := resp.Header.Get("Location")
43		if location == "" {
44			slog.Error("Version check: no redirect location found")
45			return
46		}
47	
48		// Parse version from URL
49		parsedURL, err := url.Parse(location)
50		if err != nil {
51			slog.Error("Version check: failed to parse redirect URL", "error", err)
52			return
53		}
54	
55		// Extract version from path like /releases/tag/v1.2.3
56		versionRegex := regexp.MustCompile(`/releases/tag/v?(.+)$`)
57		matches := versionRegex.FindStringSubmatch(parsedURL.Path)
58		if len(matches) < 2 {
59			slog.Error("Version check: could not extract version from path", "path", parsedURL.Path)
60			return
61		}
62	
63		latestVersion := matches[1]
64	
65		// Simple version comparison - if versions are different, assume newer
66		// This is a simple check; for more complex versioning, we'd need semantic version parsing
67		if latestVersion != currentVersion {
68			if !silent {
69				fmt.Println()
70				fmt.Println("╭─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮")
71				// Check if current version contains "beta"
72				if regexp.MustCompile(`(?i)beta`).MatchString(currentVersion) {
73					fmt.Println("│                  Beta Version in use! 🚀                    │")
74				} else {
75					fmt.Println("│                   Update Available! 🚀                      │")
76				}
77				fmt.Println("├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤")
78				fmt.Printf("│ Current version: %-42s │\n", currentVersion)
79				fmt.Printf("│ Latest version:  %-42s │\n", latestVersion)
80				fmt.Println("├─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┤")
81				fmt.Println("│ Visit https://docs.specstory.com/quickstart for updates     │")
82				fmt.Println("╰─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯")
83				fmt.Println()
84			}
85		}
86	}
87

_**Agent (claude-fable-5 2026-07-09 14:50:07Z)**_

Root cause found and confirmed: **your telemetry config points at an OTLP collector that isn't running, and the CLI blocks up to 10 seconds at exit trying to flush telemetry to it.**

The chain of evidence:

1. `specstory version` takes 10.1s wall-clock but only ~0.05s of CPU — it's waiting on the network, not doing work.
2. Your user-level config [~/.specstory/cli/config.toml](file:///Users/jakelevirne/.specstory/cli/config.toml) (line 55) has `[telemetry]` → `endpoint = "localhost:4320"` uncommented. Telemetry is enabled whenever an endpoint is configured — and nothing is listening on port 4320 on your machine right now.
3. At exit, `main()` runs a deferred `telemetry.Shutdown` with a hard-coded **10-second timeout** ([main.go:1565](specstory-cli/main.go:1565)). The OTLP gRPC exporter keeps retrying the unreachable collector until that context expires, so every command — even `specstory version` — hangs ~10s after its output before the process exits and your prompt returns.
4. Confirmation: with `OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true` (which the config code honors) the same command finishes in **0.13s**; without it, **10.13s**.

Your teammate doesn't see this because they don't have a telemetry endpoint configured — it's off by default; this setting lives in your personal `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml`, not the repo. You presumably set `localhost:4320` at some point when you were running a local OTel collector.

Two ways to fix it on your machine (I haven't touched the file):

- Comment out the `endpoint = "localhost:4320"` line in `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml`, or
- Start the collector you used to run on 4320 (the delay only happens when it's unreachable).

Separately, there's a reasonable product argument that the CLI shouldn't do this: when no spans were even recorded, or the collector is down, a 10s exit stall on every command is rough — a shorter shutdown timeout (1–2s) or a fail-fast connectivity check would keep telemetry best-effort. Happy to make that change in `specstory-cli` if you want it.

_**Agent (claude-fable-5 2026-07-09 14:53:37Z)**_

It's small — comfortably safe to do directly on `skills-interface`. Having now read the telemetry code, here's the concrete sizing:

**Where the 10s comes from:** `Shutdown` in [telemetry.go:423](specstory-cli/pkg/telemetry/telemetry.go:423) does four blocking calls (ForceFlush + Shutdown on both the trace and meter providers), all sharing the 10-second context created in [main.go:1566](specstory-cli/main.go:1566). When the collector is down, the gRPC exporters retry until that context expires.

Two implementation options, both small:

**Option A — shorten the shutdown timeout (1 line).** Change `10*time.Second` to `2*time.Second` in main.go. Pro: trivial, zero risk. Con: still a 2s stall on every command when the collector is down, and when the collector *is* up but slow, a large flush could get cut off.

**Option B — connectivity pre-check at Init (~15–20 lines, my recommendation).** In `Init`, before creating the exporters, do a `net.DialTimeout("tcp", host, ~500ms)`; if the endpoint is unreachable, log a warning and return with the no-op provider active (same path as `Enabled: false`). Pro: dead collector costs ~0.5s once at startup and exit is instant; a healthy collector keeps the full 10s flush budget, so nothing regresses for working setups. Con: if the collector comes up *mid-run* (relevant for long `specstory run` sessions), telemetry stays off for that invocation — acceptable for an opt-in dev feature, in my view.

Surface area either way: only `pkg/telemetry/telemetry.go` and possibly one line in `main.go` — nowhere near the skills code (`pkg/cmd/skills.go`, `pkg/cloud/skills.go`) this branch is actively changing, so merge-conflict risk is essentially nil. Option B plus a small table-driven test for the check is maybe 40 lines total including comments.

Want me to implement Option B (or A, or both) on this branch? If I do it here, I'll dismiss the background-task chip I created earlier since it'd be superseded.

_**Agent (claude-fable-5 2026-07-09 14:55:20Z)**_

No — the 500ms is a *cap*, not a sleep. `net.DialTimeout` returns as soon as the connection attempt resolves, and it almost always resolves fast:

- **Collector running** (the normal case): TCP connect to localhost succeeds in well under a millisecond. Remote collector: one network round-trip, typically single-digit milliseconds.
- **Collector down on localhost** (your case): the OS returns "connection refused" immediately — also ~1ms, no waiting.
- **Only the worst case hits the cap:** an unreachable remote host where packets are silently dropped (firewall, dead route, VPN black hole), or very slow DNS. There the dial waits the full 500ms before giving up.

And this check would only run at all when a telemetry endpoint is configured — for everyone running with defaults (telemetry off), it's zero added work.

So realistic impact: ~1ms per invocation for you and anyone with a local collector, 500ms once-per-command only in the pathological remote-endpoint case — versus the 10s exit stall it prevents. Want me to go ahead with it on this branch?

```go
package telemetry

import (
	"net"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

func TestEndpointReachable(t *testing.T) {
	// Real listener for the reachable case.
	listener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to start test listener: %v", err)
	}
	defer func() { _ = listener.Close() }()
	liveAddr := listener.Addr().String()

	// A port that was just released gives us a deterministic "nothing listening"
	// address without guessing port numbers.
	closedListener, err := net.Listen("tcp", "127.0.0.1:0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("failed to start throwaway listener: %v", err)
	}
	closedAddr := closedListener.Addr().String()
	_ = closedListener.Close()

	tests := []struct {
		name string
		host string
		want bool
	}{
		{
			name: "listening endpoint is reachable",
			host: liveAddr,
			want: true,
		},
		{
			name: "closed port is unreachable",
			host: closedAddr,
			want: false,
		},
		{
			name: "malformed host is unreachable",
			host: "not a host:port",
			want: false,
		},
	}

	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			start := time.Now()
			got := endpointReachable(tt.host)
			elapsed := time.Since(start)

			if got != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("endpointReachable(%q) = %v, want %v", tt.host, got, tt.want)
			}
			// The probe must never block much past its timeout — that would
			// reintroduce the startup stall this check exists to prevent.
			if elapsed > endpointDialTimeout+200*time.Millisecond {
				t.Errorf("endpointReachable(%q) took %v, expected under %v", tt.host, elapsed, endpointDialTimeout)
			}
		})
	}
}

```

running, the gRPC exporters retry until the 10-second shutdown context
expires, stalling every CLI command's exit — even `specstory version`.

local connection fails in ~1ms) before wiring up real exporters, and fall
back to the no-op provider with a logged warning when it's unreachable.
A reachable collector keeps the full flush budget, so working setups are
unaffected.

EOF
)" && git log --oneline -2
